name: pointer-multi-pointer-capability-failure
description: a multi-pointer gesture fails with a fixed detail when the driver does not report canMultiPointer
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: pointer multi unsupported
env: {}
---
- launchApp
- pointer:
    touches:
      - id: p1
        actions:
          - down:
              x: 10
              y: 10
          - up
      - id: p2
        actions:
          - down:
              x: 20
              y: 20
          - up
